corporate_loan_pct.yr2022: AB Bank PLC Annual Report 2022, Directors' Report 'Business Highlight in 2022': 'Exposure in the Corporate Banking Segment accounted for BDT 26,562 crore or 87% of the Bank's total loan portfolio... Note: 26,562/31,129 computes to ~85.3%, not 87% — reporting the bank's own explicitly-stated 87% per the no-fabrication rule (report what's stated, don't silently correct it), flagging the source's internal arithmetic mismatch.
